summary.result: Through the comparative analysis using the relative root mean square errors (RRMSE) and relative absolute errors (RAE) of design floods, the result shows that the design floods by Wakeby distribution are closer to the observed data than those obtained by the Kappa distribution.
summary.background: The objective of this study is to induce the design floods by the methodology of L-moment including test of homogeneity, independence and outlier of the data of annual maximum flood flows for 12 water level gaging stations of South Korea.
summary.method: The parameters of selected Wakeby and Kappa distributions are calculated by the method of L-moment and the design floods are induced.

summary_ko.method: 선택된 Wakeby 및 Kappa 분포의 매개변수는 L-모멘트 방법을 이용하여 계산하고, 설계홍수를 유도하였다.
summary_ko.result: 설계홍수의 상대적 평균 제곱근 오차(RRMSE) 및 상대적 절대 오차(RAE)를 이용한 비교 분석을 통해 설계홍수의 결과는 Wakeby 분포에 의한 것이 Kappa 분포에 의한 것보다 관측자료에 더 가까운 것으로 나타났다.
